name: Data List
purpose: Present repeated term/value metadata with native description-list semantics and a finished responsive recipe.
useWhen: Several related labels and values describe one record, profile, object, or specification set.

avoidWhen.condition: Items are peers rather than terms and descriptions, or the content is a columnar dataset.
avoidWhen.useInstead: List for peers or Table/Data Grid for columnar data

avoidWhen.condition: The values are editable form controls.

composition: Compose Root with Item groups; place one or more Label parts before one or more Value parts inside every Item.

rules.statement: Use Root, Item, Label, and Value so the rendered dl/div/dt/dd grammar remains valid; do not recreate the relationship with ul/li or generic Stack children.
Keep one label-then-value source order and use responsive orientation rather than duplicating mobile and desktop metadata trees.
Write visible meaningful labels; do not add empty Label parts solely to force alignment.
Load styles.css or core.css plus data-list.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using List for phone/email/title facts or adding ARIA term/definition roles to native Data List parts.
commonMistakes.correction: Use DataList native anatomy and rely on its native semantics without redundant ARIA.

validation: Check dl/div/dt/dd anatomy, complete visible labels, source order, horizontal and vertical orientation, long values, links inside Value, zoom, RTL, forced colors, and CSS loading.
